Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
Let the Lord be praised. O you servants of the Lord, give praise to the name of the Lord.
你們要讚美耶和華！耶和華的僕人哪，你們要讚美，讚美耶和華的名！
Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
Let blessing be on the name of the Lord, from this time and for ever.
耶和華的名是應當稱頌的，從今時直到永遠！
From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
From the coming up of the sun to its going down, the Lord's name is to be praised.
從日出之地到日落之處，耶和華的名是應當讚美的！
The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.
The Lord is high over all nations, and his glory is higher than the heavens.
耶和華超乎萬民之上；他的榮耀高過諸天。
Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on high,
誰像耶和華─我們的神呢？他坐在至高之處，
He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
Looking down on the heavens, and on the earth?
自己謙卑，觀看天上地下的事。
He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
He takes the poor man out of the dust, lifting him up from his low position;
他從灰塵裡抬舉貧寒人，從糞堆中提拔窮乏人，
to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
To give him a place among the rulers, even with the rulers of his people.
使他們與王子同坐，就是與本國的王子同坐。
He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!
He gives the unfertile woman a family, making her a happy mother of children. Give praise to the Lord.
他使不能生育的婦人安居家中，為多子的樂母。你們要讚美耶和華！
